checks.name: anti-slop-heuristic
checks.evidence: Canonical scanner: 100/100 for the repo. This keyword heuristic is not a visual quality score.

checks.name: secret-intake
checks.evidence: Repo scan found ten generic-key matches, all inside ignored .next cache/server manifests. No findings outside generated .next. Values were redacted; no global hook or scanner rule was disabled.

checks.name: production-build
checks.evidence: Final pp admission BOUNDED, 11935 MB available. Final pnpm run build passed compilation, TypeScript and all 26 generated pages, including six study and six editor routes. Both new route families use generateStaticParams and dynamicParams=false.

checks.name: prerender-contract
checks.evidence: All twelve generated study/editor HTML files have the expected data-template, exactly one h1 and noindex, nofollow. This is server HTML evidence, not browser, HTTP-404 or visual QA.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: 22 browser exports captured in cloud CI; music and lab at desktop/phone inspected. Capture refinement now waits for GSAP opacity to settle before exporting. Remaining images and final settled exports need inspection.

checks.name: offline-brief-export
checks.evidence: Six Markdown briefs, six JSON configurations, an index and SHA-256 receipts exported by pnpm run template:briefs. Two added tests verify contents, repeatability, preservation of prior edits and packaging inclusion; 24 template/export/contract tests pass.

checks.name: immutable-source-package
checks.evidence: 63 files packaged from aa73e34c300fe9de896a5c8e7d537bd34d6a3978 with file hashes and archive checksum. Status PACKAGED_NOT_RELEASED; packaging does not assert application or launch verification.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Real Chromium flow, overflow, route and reduced-motion checks passed in run 34483542984. Manual export inspection began; this is not an independent buyer or full accessibility certification.

checks.name: independent-buyer-critic

checks.name: audio-origin-boundary
checks.evidence: 32 affected tests pass on Node 22, including same-origin blob acceptance and rejection of malformed, remote, data, JavaScript and foreign-origin blob URLs. TypeScript and scoped ESLint pass. Fresh CodeQL still pending; no alert suppressed. Fresh CodeQL at bfbb52d and 3e0d811 passed and marked the original alert fixed.
